title: Start here: the current prompt, a sample track and a way to check your own
outcome: Someone new opens the Tracks README, copies the current recommended prompt, sees a sample track, and checks their own track file in a few steps.
why_now: Anyone can use it is the product goal, but the lab's v4.0.0 prompt written on 10-28 is still not in the library and there is no single place to start.
scope_in: A start section at the top of the README with the recommended prompt, a sample track and how to validate a file; v4.0.0 published as the library's current variant with its sample.
scope_out: The claude.ai connector, a hosted service, or new prompt research.
done_when: The README opens with the start section; the prompt file matches the lab's v4.0.0 text and the variants table names it current; validate_track.py passes on every sample track, including the new one.
reason: new initiative for goal 1

title: The format holds: spec, validator and viewer agree
outcome: Every rule in the format spec is checked by the validator, a broken file fails with the rule named, and any valid track opens in the viewer as a static page with no server.
why_now: A portable record is only portable if the spec and the tools agree; today the viewer needs serve.py and no test ties spec rules to validator checks.
scope_in: A test mapping each spec rule to a validator check; a broken fixture per rule; the viewer opening a dropped track file as a static page.
scope_out: Changing the format itself, editing tracks in the viewer, or hosting the viewer.
done_when: A test maps each spec rule to a validator check, all samples pass and a broken fixture fails with its rule named; a browser test drops a sample track on the static viewer and sees its turns, decisions and open items with no server running.
reason: new initiative for goal 1

title: The wheel's own sessions pick up from their last track
outcome: A new session in a wheel project opens with the last session's open items and decisions from its track, and ideas stranded in old tracks are listed as lug candidates.
why_now: Using Tracks ourselves is the proof it is worth using; the wheel's wake-ups still read other records, and old tracks hold ideas no one picked up.
scope_in: A session-start step that prints the last track's open items and decisions; a read-only script that lists open ideas in old tracks with their track and line.
scope_out: Writing lugs automatically, changing the hub's wake-up beyond reading the last track, or other people's projects.
done_when: In a test project a session start prints the last track's open items and decisions, covered by a fixture test; a script over sample tracks lists open ideas with their track and line and writes nothing.
reason: new initiative for goal 2
